seo.title: Living Sculpture Sanctuary · Garden Weddings & Celebrations in Davie
seo.description: Garden weddings and celebrations at Living Sculpture Sanctuary in Davie: century-old oaks, waterfalls, koi ponds and a bonsai wall, for up to 170 guests. Music, lighting and production by Avinu Events.

hero.lead: Century-old oaks, cascading waterfalls, koi ponds and a bonsai wall: a sanctuary built by hand, with ceremonies by the falls and receptions under the oaks for up to 170 guests.

intro.h2: A garden built by hand, for celebrations
paras: Founders Mary Luz Rodríguez Álvarez and Robert J. McKee, two trial attorneys who share a love for nature, built the Sanctuary with their own hands, and took their own wedding vows on its grounds.

Since 2016 it has welcomed weddings and celebrations among century-old oaks, waterfalls, koi ponds, a bonsai wall and a Zen rock garden. In 2026 it opened IBUKU Avalon, a new hall where the indoors and outdoors become one.

film.h2: From the falls to the oaks at night
film.text: A ceremony beneath the oaks, a first dance in the Sanctuary Center and tables by the fire after dark. Choose a moment.

spaces.text: The Signature rental opens every area of the Sanctuary for the ceremony, cocktail hour and reception.

items.name: Healing Falls Esplanade
items.text: A trinity of waterfalls with colored LED lights, hundred-year-old oaks and a fireplace where fire meets water.

items.name: Life’s Journey Trail
items.text: Zen Moon Gates for past, present and future, the Tree of One and the Cascade of Light.

items.name: Orchid Forest Stroll
items.text: A path of orchids past the Rock Zen Garden, the bonsai wall and the Sacred Fire Boulder.

items.name: Sanctuary Center
items.text: A covered rustic pavilion with an onyx bar, organic chandeliers and an arch bridge over the koi ponds.

items.name: Zen Lounge
items.text: An air-conditioned lounge with an amethyst entrance, private bath and a veranda over the lake.

spaces.note: Capacities from the Sanctuary. IBUKU Avalon, the new indoor hall opened in 2026, is listed for 180 guests on PartySlate; confirm current layouts with the Sanctuary.

reviews.src: Reviews from WeddingWire and the Sanctuary · Rating from Google

items.q: Everyone should trust Mary Luz with their wedding, she has put together an incredible team of vendors that will make your day seamless and easy.
The brand new Ibuku indoor space is absolutely stunning.
Our wedding day despite the rain, was absolutely stunning.

production.text: Avinu Events produces the entertainment for celebrations across South Florida, from Miami Beach to Boca Raton: the music for the ceremony, the energy of the dance floor and the light that shapes the room.
production.lighting: Uplighting for the oaks and the Sanctuary Center, dance-floor lighting and LED effects planned around the Sanctuary’s rules: no confetti, glitter or open flame, and music that ends on time at 11 pm.
